title: AsyncCallback
description: Inbound async callback message delivered by an external service after an async service.invoke step. Part of the Tracto Common Execution Contract v1.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this callback event. Used for deduplication.

sourceRunId.description: Run identifier of the execution that initiated the service.invoke step this callback answers.

sourceStepId.description: Step identifier of the service.invoke step this callback answers.

nonce.description: Single-use token from the original callbackConfig.nonce. Validators MUST verify this matches the nonce issued with the request to prevent replay.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp at which the external service produced this callback.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the callback payload, produced by the external service. Validators should verify this before accepting the message.

payload.description: Arbitrary structured data returned by the external service. Schema is service-specific.

serviceOutcome.description: The outcome reported by the external service for the invoked operation.

authenticated.description: MUST NOT be accepted as a self-assertion of authentication status. Validators must ignore or reject authenticated:true claims. Authentication is established through the transport channel (mutual-TLS or token), not through this field.

continuationRuleId.description: Optional identifier of the static continuation rule to activate upon receipt of this callback. If absent, default continuation logic applies.
